name: dsh-bot-board
description: Bot 看板 — DS Bot 的浮动实时看板：每个 Bot 现在在干什么、跑了多久、卡在哪、谁在等谁交活

scripts.check: node tools/build.mjs && node tools/smoke.mjs && node --import ./tools/register-shim.mjs tools/render-check.mjs
scripts.ci: node tools/verify-artifact.mjs && node tools/smoke.mjs && node --import ./tools/register-shim.mjs tools/render-check.mjs
scripts.freeze: node tools/verify-artifact.mjs && echo 'src-only:' && cat src/host/index.js src/client/*.js | shasum -a 256 && echo 'artifact:' && shasum -a 256 client.js && node tools/smoke.mjs > /dev/null && node --import ./tools/register-shim.mjs tools/render-check.mjs > /dev/null && echo 'checks: green'
